items.title: A randomized, placebo-controlled, clinical trial of high-dose supplementation with vitamins C and E, beta carotene, and zinc for age-related macular degeneration and vision loss: AREDS report no. 8.
authors: Age-Related Eye Disease Study Research Group
items.summary: AREDS report showing high-dose vitamins C and E, beta carotene, and zinc supplements reduce progression of intermediate to advanced AMD by 25% over 6.3 years.

items.title: Antioxidant vitamin and mineral supplements for slowing the progression of age-related macular degeneration.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review confirming antioxidant vitamin and mineral supplements slow progression of intermediate AMD to advanced stages.

items.title: Geographic Atrophy in Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
items.summary: Review of geographic atrophy in AMD, noting 2023 FDA approval of complement inhibitors pegcetacoplan and avacincaptad pegol for treatment.

items.title: Treatment of dry age-related macular degeneration: A review.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of dry AMD treatments including complement pathway inhibitors, visual cycle modulators, and other therapeutic categories under investigation.

items.title: The Diagnosis and Treatment of Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
items.summary: Clinical review of AMD diagnosis and treatment, covering risk factors, clinical manifestations, and current therapeutic approaches.

items.title: Treatment for dry age-related macular degeneration: where we stand in 2024.
items.summary: 2024 update on dry AMD treatment options, highlighting two approved treatments for geographic atrophy in the United States.

items.title: Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Therapeutic Management and New-Upcoming Approaches.
items.summary: Review of neovascular AMD therapeutic management focusing on anti-VEGF therapy as standard treatment and emerging approaches.

items.title: Screening for Impaired Visual Acuity in Older Adults: Updated Evidence Report and Systematic Review for the US Preventive Services Task Force.
items.summary: USPSTF systematic review on screening for impaired visual acuity in older adults, including evidence on AMD treatment effectiveness.

items.title: Transpupillary thermotherapy for the treatment of occult CNV in age-related macular degeneration: a prospective randomized controlled pilot study.
items.summary: Randomized controlled trial showing transpupillary thermotherapy failed to reduce moderate visual loss in occult choroidal neovascularization secondary to AMD.

items.title: The effects of dorzolamide on choroidal and retinal perfusion in non-exudative age related macular degeneration.
items.summary: Randomized trial demonstrating dorzolamide had no beneficial effects on choroidal and retinal perfusion in non-exudative AMD patients.

items.title: Saffron therapy for the treatment of mild/moderate age-related macular degeneration: a randomised clinical trial.
items.journal: Graefe's archive for clinical and experimental ophthalmology = Albrecht von Graefes Archiv fur klinische und experimentelle Ophthalmologie
items.summary: Randomized crossover trial showing oral saffron supplementation provided no significant benefit for mild/moderate AMD treatment.

items.title: Antiangiogenesis agents.
items.summary: Review noting interferon alpha-2a proved ineffective in halting neovascular AMD progression in double-masked, placebo-controlled clinical trial.

canonicalFacts.claim: AMD is subdivided into early, intermediate, and late stages, with the early stage often being asymptomatic
Anti-VEGF therapy has become the standard treatment for neovascular AMD and dramatically changed the disease prognosis
Two complement inhibitors, pegcetacoplan and avacincaptad pegol, were approved in the USA in 2023 for geographic atrophy treatment
High-dose antioxidant vitamins and zinc supplements reduce progression from intermediate to advanced AMD
Advanced dry AMD characterized by geographic atrophy is a leading cause of blindness in the developed world

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Consider antioxidant vitamin and mineral supplementation for intermediate AMD based on AREDS formulation

redFlags: Beta carotene supplementation may increase lung cancer risk in smokers
Anti-VEGF injections carry risks of endophthalmitis and retinal detachment
